name: Outbound Access Protection for DI
description: Fabric administrators want to ensure that data in Fabric isnt exfiltrated to unpermitted destinations outside of Fabric unintentionally or by malicious intent . In this milestone, we will provide controls to ensure Data Factory items:  Dataflows Gen2 (with CICD), Data Pipelines and Copy Job can only connect to the specific data sources and connectors as configured by Workspace Admins.
